applyTo: 'contents/en/**/*.md'

# English style guide

When reviewing or creating English documents in the `contents/en/` directory, follow these style guides:

* For general English writing, refer to the English style guide in this repository: [docs/general-style-guide-english.md](../../docs/general-style-guide-english.md).
* For help-documentation style writing, refer to [docs/technical-style-guide-english.md](../../docs/technical-style-guide-english.md).
* For official English-Japanese term translations, refer to [docs/glossary.yaml](../../docs/glossary.yaml).
* For Markdown formatting, follow [docs/markdown-style-guide.md](../../docs/markdown-style-guide.md).


## Note

* The `applyTo` in this file targets `contents/en/**/*.md`. It does not affect changes outside English documents.
* Reference paths are relative within the repository. If you move or rename files, remember to update the referenced paths as well.
* Follow the Markdown syntax conventions used in this repository for consistency. See `.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc` for the specific rules applied.
